cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: The Logic Gets Bigger
cards.instruction: Use every new detail to expand the impossible system, its history, and the consequences of breaking it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our soup bowl said hello. Use the greeting I taught you; crockery hasn't spoken since the Great Washing-Up. Don't just nod at it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Trade has reopened. Offer a roll, butter separate. You used to put every gift in one basket; that's how the gravy embargo began.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it wants a seat at dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're being taken seriously. A seat means recognition as a nation. Move the plates apart, the way I showed you, before we accidentally concede its borders.
